articles.title: Nvidia hits pause on chip shipments to Southeast Asia
articles.description: Nvidia has told manufacturing partners to pause server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia as the U.S. tightens its push to keep AI chips out of China.
articles.author: Connie Loizos

articles.title: Grand Theft Auto VI proves why efficiency isn’t a virtue
articles.description: On the same day that Anthropic entered the public market, a painstakingly human video game became one of most successful entertainment launches of all time.
articles.author: Amanda Silberling
